description: This file defines the GatewayTooBusyException class, a specialized exception indicating a load-related overload of a gateway silo in Orleans.

classes.name: GatewayTooBusyException
classes.description: A sealed exception class indicating that a gateway silo is overloaded and cannot process the message.

methods.name: GatewayTooBusyException()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the exception with a standard message.

methods.name: GatewayTooBusyException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message.

methods.name: GatewayTooBusyException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a message and an inner exception for chaining.
